newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Equigold sets gold hedge programme.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Equigold sets gold hedge programme.

text.p: Miner Equigold Ltd said on Wednesday it has placed forward gold sales covering the first 40,000 ounces of its share of production from the Dalgaranga mine in Western Australia.

The sales program was based on a spot gold price of A$528 an ounce which would result in the company achieving a flat forward price of A$542 an ounce for the company's share of gold production to the end of June 1998, Equigold company secretary Mark Clark said.
"Our share of production is about 27,000 ounces a year," Clark told Reuters.
Cash costs at Dalgaranga are budgeted at about A$340 an ounce and the forward sale program will ensure a solid profit margin on production for the first 18 months, the company said.
Gold currently fetches about A$446 an ounce.
Equigold holds a 50.1 percent interest in the mine. The rest is held by Western Reefs Ltd.
